shots.description_tr: Açılış. Kapkara, huzursuz deniz; fener huzmesi karanlıktan kameraya doğru süzülür, kadrajı bir an altına boğar; geçince burnun ucunda ay altında beyaz kule silueti belirir.
shots.image_prompt: Opening frame, extreme wide shot from far out at sea looking back at the shore, low horizon, vast negative space of pitch-black restless water in the foreground; the white lighthouse stands as a small silhouette at the tip of the headland under the moon, its warm beam pointing off to the side, about to swing toward camera; no people, no glowing sphere over the water, no boats. a rocky North Aegean headland: dark grey wet rocks covered in seaweed running from the foot of a tall white stone lighthouse with a black iron cupola down into the sea, waves breaking over the rocks in white foam; a small arched wooden door at the base of the tower; a narrow dirt coastal path lined with dry pale grass curving inland away from the tower; open sea to the horizon; navy-black sea, moon between clouds, the lighthouse beam sweeping across the water. night, cold steel-blue moonlight and deep navy shadows, the only warm light is amber-gold (#F2A541), strong warm-cold contrast. cinematic still, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lens, soft organic film grain, subtle halation, oval bokeh, low-key naturalistic lighting, muted colour grade, photorealistic, highly detailed textures, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logo
shots.video_prompt: The warm amber lighthouse beam slowly rotates and sweeps across the dark water toward the camera, briefly flooding the whole frame with golden light, then passes on, revealing the white tower in silhouette under the moon. Restless black waves heave and roll, clouds drift slowly past the moon. Camera almost static. Sound: deep rolling sea, low wind, distant waves breaking on rocks. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: Forty-one years. The same light. The same sea.
shots.notes: Fade-in from black. cape_night referansında küre var: prompt'ta 'no glowing sphere' korunmalı. Huzme kameraya dönünce aşırı patlama (tam beyaz kare) olursa kurgucu o anı kısa tutar.

shots.description_tr: Nuri dönen Fresnel merceğinin yanında, camı bezle yavaş ve özenli silikliyor; ışık düzenli ritimle yüzünden ve paltosundan geçiyor.
shots.image_prompt: Medium-wide interior shot, Nuri standing beside the large turning Fresnel lens, wiping its glass with a soft cloth, his face in three-quarter profile and the lens filling the right of frame, hands small in frame and partly hidden by the cloth, focus on his face and the glowing prisms; warm light passing across his face and coat. shots.video_prompt: The old keeper slowly and carefully wipes the glass of the turning Fresnel lens with a cloth in long, gentle strokes; the warm light inside the lens rotates, passing across his face and coat in a steady rhythm. Camera static with an imperceptibly slow push-in. Sound: the soft creak and tick of old clockwork turning the lens, cloth on glass, muffled wind against the windows. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: Tomorrow, a machine keeps the watch.
shots.notes: El anatomisi riski: eller küçük ve bezle kısmen örtülü kalmalı.

shots.camera: static, rack focus not required (foreground sharp)

Camera completely static. Sound: a faint electric hum from the cabinet, the slow creak of the lens clockwork, wind on the glass. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: The light can turn itself now, they said.
shots.notes: Dolapta yazı/etiket/sayı çıkmamalı (denetimde kontrol). Yeşil LED ortamı aydınlatmamalı.

shots.description_tr: Galeri, yan açı: Nuri iki koluyla demir korkuluğa yaslanmış, kara denize bakıyor; rüzgâr palto eteğini kaldırıyor, huzme başının üstünden geçiyor.

Camera static. Sound: strong steady wind, flapping wool, the sea far below. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: I never knew who my light reached.
shots.notes: Galeri çekimi: LOC_LAMP_ROOM bloğu başına 'outside on the narrow gallery of' eklendi.

shots.description_tr: Nuri'nin bakış açısı: boş denizin üstünde karanlık ufuk. Tam ortada, çok uzakta, küçük sıcak altın bir ışık suyun hemen üstünde yavaşça belirir.

Dead centre on the far horizon, the tiny golden point of light slowly brightens and becomes clearly visible, hovering just above the water, staying the same tiny size and in the same place. Gentle swell moves across the black water, clouds drift past the moon. Camera completely still. Sound: wind and distant waves only. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.notes: RİSK: ışığın ölçeği (ay boyutunda çizilme eğilimi). Anahtar kare ışığı çok sönük ama mevcut gösterir; klipte 'belirme' parlaklaşma ile sağlanır. Klip 2 varyant önerilir.

shots.description_tr: Nuri'nin yüzüne yakın: gözleri kısılır, hafifçe öne eğilir. Huzme yüzünden geçip gider; karanlıkta gözlerinde uzak ışığın minik yansıması kalır.

Camera static with a very slow push-in. Sound: wind gusting past the gallery, his quiet breath. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: No ship ever sailed out there. Nothing ever did.
shots.notes: Göz yansıması küçük kalmalı; abartılı parlama olmamalı.

shots.description_tr: Galeride arkadan geniş: ön planda Nuri'nin sırtı ve omzu, ötede denizdeki ışık. Işık 'iki kısa, bir uzun' ritmiyle yanıp söner; fenerin kendi huzmesi de aynı ritimle geçer.

shots.video_prompt: Far out on the horizon the tiny golden point of light flashes in a clear rhythm: two short flashes, then one long flash, pause, and again two short, one long; at the same time the lighthouse's own warm beam sweeps past overhead in the same rhythm. The keeper stands motionless with his back to us, his coat stirring in the wind. Camera static. Sound: wind, distant sea, the soft creak of the lens machinery. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: That was my signal. Two short... one long.
shots.notes: Ritim kurguda desteklenecek (Veo 'two short, one long' ritmini güvenilir üretmeyebilir; kurgucu gerekirse parlaklık/hız düzenlemesi veya kare tekrarıyla ritmi kurar). Işık uzak, küçük net altın nokta kalmalı. Klip 2 varyant önerilir.

Camera static with a slight pan following him. Sound: boots on the iron floor, the lantern's handle creaking, wind against the glass, faint electric hum. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.notes: lamp_room referansına göre kanca merdiven kapağının yanındaki direkte; fener o kancada asılı başlar. Sönük fener (PROP_LANTERN unlit).

Camera locked off. Sound: slow boot steps ringing on cast iron, echo in the stone tower, faint wind from the slit window. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: Forty-one years looking down. Tonight, I go down.
shots.notes: RİSK: tepe kadrajda inişin perspektifi ve figürün tutarlılığı (Veo sarmalda yönü şaşırabilir). stairwell.png filigranı: sağ alt köşe kontrol. Klip 2 varyant önerilir.

Camera static, low. Sound: waves swelling louder, crashing and hissing over the rocks, wind. No speech, no voices, no music.

Camera static. Sound: waves breaking on rocks, wind, and a very soft, warm low hum rising as the light comes closer. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.notes: Senaryoda 'wide'; S10 ile ardışık iki geniş olmaması için medium-wide (tam figür) yapıldı. RİSK: küre yaklaşırken büyüyüp ay/güneş boyuna çıkma eğilimi. Klip 2 varyant önerilir.

shots.description_tr: Önden orta: ışık kayaların dibinde dalgaların hemen üstünde asılı. Nuri'nin yüzü ilk kez alttan sıcak altınla aydınlanır; soğuk mavi gecede tek sıcak yüz.

NURI, a 72-year-old man of North Aegean Mediterranean appearance, tall but slightly stooped, lean build; deeply lined weathered face with wind-reddened cheeks, short fully white-grey beard neatly trimmed close to the jaw, pale grey eyes, tired but warm expression; wearing a dark grey knitted wool beanie covering his hair, a thick cream cable-knit fisherman's sweater with a roll neck, a knee-length navy wool pea coat with two rows of brass buttons worn open, dark grey wool trousers, black knee-high rubber boots. a rocky North Aegean headland: dark grey wet rocks covered in seaweed running from the foot of a tall white stone lighthouse with a black iron cupola down into the sea, waves breaking over the rocks in white foam; a small arched wooden door at the base of the tower; a narrow dirt coastal path lined with dry pale grass curving inland away from the tower; open sea to the horizon; navy-black sea, moon between clouds, the lighthouse beam sweeping across the water. night, cold steel-blue moonlight and deep navy shadows, the only warm light is amber-gold (#F2A541), strong warm-cold contrast. cinematic still, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lens, soft organic film grain, subtle halation, oval bokeh, low-key naturalistic lighting, muted colour grade, photorealistic, highly detailed textures, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logo
shots.video_prompt: The golden sphere hovers gently just above the waves, softly pulsing; its warm light flickers subtly over the keeper's face from below as he looks down at it in quiet wonder, barely moving. Waves wash over the rocks below. Camera static with a very slow push-in. Sound: waves lapping the rocks, wind, a soft warm hum. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.voiceover: All the light I ever gave away... came back.
shots.notes: Yüz sabit, alttan sıcak aydınlatma (stil rehberi S12–S14).

shots.description_tr: Yandan orta-geniş: Nuri sönük feneri yavaşça göğüs hizasına kaldırır. Küre sudan yükselir, fenerin cam şişesine kendiliğinden süzülür ve fener sıcak, titrek bir alevle canlanır. (Dokunma yok.)

shots.video_prompt: The golden sphere rises slowly from just above the water, drifts through the air on its own and glides into the lantern's glass chimney, shrinking softly as it enters; the lantern comes alive with a small warm flickering flame and a soft amber glow. The keeper holds the lantern perfectly still, his hand barely moving, warm light blooming over his face. Camera static. Sound: the hum of the light rising, then settling into the gentle flutter of a flame, waves below. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.notes: END_FRAME: Medium-wide side-angle shot, the same old keeper in profile on the dark rocks holding at chest height an old brass hurricane lantern with a clear glass chimney and a wire carrying handle, tarnished and worn brass, lit from within by a small warm flickering flame, soft amber glow; no sphere of light anywhere over the water, the lantern is now the only warm source, gold light on his face, cold blue night around, same framing as the start frame. || RİSK: filmin en zor çekimi (küre→fener geçişi, el sabit). Klip 2 varyant önerilir. YEDEK PLAN (yönetmen; senaryoda ayrı yedek plan yazılı değil, senaryonun 'dokunma yok, minimum el hareketi' kısıtına uyar): (1) END_FRAME'li klip başarısızsa END_FRAME olmadan, küre camın içine girip parlak bir sıcak ışık 'bloom'u ile kapanacak şekilde üret; kurgucu parlamanın tepe noktasında S14'e keser, S14'teki alttan sıcak fener ışığı yanmayı tamamlar. (2) O da olmazsa çekim ikiye bölünür: S13a küre yükselip cama yaklaşır (4 sn), S13b yanan fenerin insert'i (END_FRAME karesinden kısa hareketli klip, 3–4 sn) — +1 klip kredisi.

shots.camera: locked-off, looking up at the tower
shots.description_tr: Şafak, kuleye aşağıdan geniş: soluk mavi. Lamba odasındaki eski sıcak turuncu ışık yavaşça söner; bir an karanlık kalır, sonra keskin, soğuk beyaz yeni ışık yanar ve dönmeye başlar.
shots.image_prompt: Wide low-angle shot looking up at the white lighthouse tower from the rocks at dawn, the tower filling the centre of frame against a pale overcast sky; the glass lantern room at the top still glowing with the old warm orange Fresnel light, the only warm light in the cold scene; no people, no glowing sphere. a rocky North Aegean headland: dark grey wet rocks covered in seaweed running from the foot of a tall white stone lighthouse with a black iron cupola down into the sea, waves breaking over the rocks in white foam; a small arched wooden door at the base of the tower; a narrow dirt coastal path lined with dry pale grass curving inland away from the tower; open sea to the horizon. early dawn, soft flat pale blue-grey light, overcast sky with a thin pale pink line on the horizon, no direct sun, quiet and cold. cinematic still, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lens, soft organic film grain, subtle halation, oval bokeh, low-key naturalistic lighting, muted colour grade, photorealistic, highly detailed textures, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no logo
shots.video_prompt: At the top of the tower the old warm orange light in the lantern room slowly fades out and goes dark; for a beat the glass room stays dark against the pale sky; then a sharp, cold white electric light switches on and begins to turn. Clouds drift slowly. Camera completely static. Sound: the slow creak of old clockwork winding down and stopping, a moment of silence with soft waves, then a thin electric hum. No speech, no voices, no music.
shots.notes: END_FRAME: Wide low-angle shot looking up at the same white stone lighthouse with a black iron cupola at early dawn, soft flat pale blue-grey light, the glass lantern room at the top now shining with a sharp cold white electric light (#E6F0FF), no warm orange light anywhere, same framing as the start frame. || RİSK: cape_dawn referansı zaten soğuk beyaz ışık gösteriyor; başlangıç karesinde sıcak turuncu ışığın baskın kalması prompt'a bağlı (denetimde kontrol). Geceden şafağa dissolve. Klip 2 varyant önerilir. Yedek: geçiş Veo'da olmazsa kurgucu sıcak (başlangıç karesi) ve soğuk (END_FRAME) hâllerini kısa siyah/karanlık ara ile çapraz geçişle kurar.

shots.description_tr: Son görüntü, şafak, çok geniş: solda kule soğuk beyaz huzmesini döndürüyor; sağda Nuri sırtı bize dönük kıyı patikasında yavaşça uzaklaşıyor. Feneri, mavi-gri manzaradaki tek sıcak nokta. Ufukta ince pembe çizgi.

shots.voiceover: Let the sea keep its own light now.
